newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable in range trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable in range trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in range trading on Friday, dealers said.
They said trading was slightly slow, with operators winding down for the weekend and making some short dollar covering.
Spot rupiah was at 2,610.0/13.0 at 0215 GMT against an opening of 2,613/23. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,610.75/12.75 and 2,609.25/11.25, respectively.
"It looks like a slow day. We see some short covering ahead of the weekend," one Japanese bank dealer said, adding swaps were rather biddish on the back of a tight money market.
Dealers said the market appeared to be a bit tight at the opening because there was no repo offer from the central bank and no purchase of short-term securities (SBPUs).
However, overnight swap eased down to 1.4 from 2.0 after opening at 0.75 points. Tom/next was at 0.10/0.15 points.
One U.S. bank dealer said investment houses were seen sustaining dollar selling interest while meeting selective counters from local purchases.
"But weekend dollar covering seems to limit dollar downside although liquidity appears to be a bit tight," he added.
The dealer expected the rupiah to range trade between 2,605 and 2,615 for the rest of the day.
Dealers said the market was calmer, in line with more stable regional markets on Friday morning.
One-month swap rose to 16.0/19.0 from 15.0/16.5 on Thursday, two to 36.0/46.0 from 33.0/35.0, three to 55.0/60.0 from 50.0/54.0 and six to 109.0/116.0 from 106.0/110.0 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,378/2,682 but raised the conversion band to 2,575/2,623 on Thursday from 2,559/2,607 on Wednesday.
